description:
Presented in walk-in condition, this bright and spacious three-bedroom semi-detached family home enjoys a quiet cul-de-sac setting within the popular Raithín Eoghain development, just minutes from Mullingar town centre. Offering generous accommodation, modern finishes and an excellent location close to schools, shops and everyday amenities, this superb home is ideal for first-time buyers or young families.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall with tiled flooring, leading to a spacious sitting room centred around a solid fuel stove. To the rear, the modern kitchen and dining area is fitted with an excellent range of wall and floor units, quartz worktops, tiled splashbacks and generous dining space. A separate utility room provides additional storage and a guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous primary bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en-suite. The remaining bedrooms are bright and spacious, with fitted wardrobes in the second bedroom, while the fully tiled family bathroom is finished to a high standard with an electric shower.

Externally, the property benefits from ample off-street parking, a private rear patio area, side access, a timber garden shed, exterior lighting, outdoor sockets and an exterior tap.

Raithín Eoghain is a well-established development conveniently located within walking distance of Mullingar town centre, Tesco Shopping Centre, a wide range of sporting and recreational amenities. The nearby Ring Road, N52 and N4 motorway provide excellent connectivity for commuters.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
